newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down as blue chips fall.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down as blue chips fall.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down on Sunday amid profit taking on blue chip shares by retail investors, said brokers.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 40.87 points or 2.29 percent at 1,740.86 on a turnover of 106.4 million taka. Of 123 traded issues 17 gained and 100 lost and six unchanged.
Leasing company IDLC lost 98 taka to 4,912, Atlas Bangladesh shed 447 to 377 and Bangladesh Oxyzen was down 5.0 to 230. ((-- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363))
